required_firmware_behavior: Refuse self-test and scan while validated is false or the hardware/limits revisions do not match.

safety_boundary.intended_use: Disconnected, de-energized passive cables and harnesses at a supervised indoor dry bench.
prohibited: powered USB through a test bank
hipot, insulation, impedance, bandwidth, precision-resistance, or cable-certification claims

electrical.warning: The plus/minus 5 V calculation is a bounded accidental single-endpoint stress check while USB-powered, not an operating rating or permission for energized testing. Simultaneous multi-endpoint external drive, unpowered backfeed, higher-energy sources, and transients require separate analysis and remain prohibited.

precheck.bias_reference_high_control: BIAS_CTRL input/high-impedance; REF3318 feeds BIAS through 1 kOhm
precheck.external_source_detection_note: The committed sweep shows every fixed source at -5, -1, 0, 1.8, 3.3, and 5 V with 0 or 10 kOhm source resistance fails at least one phase. Arbitrarily high-impedance sources are outside the guaranteed detection model and deliver correspondingly bounded current; bench characterization remains mandatory.
precheck.threshold_status: provisional; must be replaced or ratified by tolerance sweep and controlled bench data in issue #7

stimulus_levels: STIM low with BIAS at measured 1.8 V reference
continuity.threshold_status: provisional; contact resistance, cable capacitance, ADC noise, mux settling, fixture leakage, and temperature remain unmeasured

environment.note: Selected silicon is generally specified over wider ranges, but PinPath system limits are not validated until physical characterization.

evidence.spice: not run; no ngspice, ltspice, or xyce was installed
evidence.physical: none; no fabricated or assembled prototype exists

bench_gates_before_validated_true: measure 3V3 and ADC reference across intended USB supply and temperature range
sweep each endpoint precheck with bounded positive and negative laboratory sources through a safe fixture
verify open and connected margins for group sizes 1 through 32 and representative cable/contact resistance
measure GPIO/mux current for ground short, endpoint contention fault injection, and multi-node shorts
capture reset, BOOTSEL, watchdog, USB disconnect, cancel, and malformed-command safe-state behavior
verify every enable remains low while unpowered/reset and no test-bank endpoint is actively driven
record instruments, uncertainty, hardware revision, firmware revision, conditions, and raw results
